Nee first embarrassment. Nee first heartbreak. Nee first job rejection. Ila ninnu balavanthanga balavanthudiga chesina prathi vishyam modhalu ayyedhi discomfort ane feeling lonche. 

Manalni padukonivvakunda chese feelings ni negative gaane chusthaam kabati, ee emotion ni kuda adhe category lo kukkesi, dhaaniki character lekunda chesesaam. But koncham bootha’addham petti chudatam manesthe, ninnu nuvu sanka nakipokunda kaapadukotaniki kavaalsina saamaanlu anni burra lo perchi pedthundhi, neeku nachakapoyina. 

Nee life loki discomfort anedhi chaala getuplu yesukoni osthundhi.
- Oka saari, nee intiki free ga dengithinataaniki ochi, “nee manchike chepthunna” ani free ga advice iche rupam lo.
- Inko saari, nuvu guddi ga premisthe, guddodni chesi dobbuthaaru ane clarity lo.
- Maro saari, nuvu namminodu nee trigger pointlu meedha jokelu yesi, “casual ga annam ra” ani cheppina moment lo.

Ila ninnu ukkiribikkiri chese yeshaalaki, samadhanam vethukkune la chese push button ae ‘discomfort’. 

- Nee limitations penche panulu chepisthundhi.
- Rejection kaadhu, redirection ani ardham avthundhi. 
- Heartbreak lo self-respect conceptlu vethukkovatam nerpisthundhi. 
- Jealousy kastha clarity ga, bhayam kaastha courage la maaripothundhi.

Last ki thelisedhi okate, nee life lo jarigina prathi kashtam, nee vennu mukka ni thatti, ballanga nilapettatam kosame ani.

I know life gets busier, shit gets piled up or you might lose track on how it used to be before, or you might as well be chasing something you don't like but don't want to see someone else owning it. Find just a minute to say a silly thing to them even though they think you sound dumb but they will know you are trying to keep up the vibe/ relationship alive. It's like that long term postal scheme, you got to invest your time, you got to keep checking now and then to see how much you saved. You may get irritated to get something in return but it stays with you like a very stable rock. ⁣
⁣
I'm sure you will end up in regrets before you die, just ensure you don't regret for not able to to be silly with them but were able to be careless  enough to lose them. ⁣
⁣
Irrespective of whoever you are, whatever you are going through, you need someone always. And that someone should start with yourself, a friend, a partner, parents, may be a online friend, or a stranger who listens to your crap. Luckily if you got one already, thank them silly. ⁣
